verdicts.title: §7.1 'R-adapt == R32 in every block, all three points' is stated without restriction to the base runs; the b*-b05 variant differs in one block at C2 +6 dB
verdicts.reason: Confirmed by npz recount. For the base runs (V1|base, bstar|base) R-adapt vs R32 differ in 0 blocks at C2_m3, C2_p6 and C5_m3, and all V1 variants also differ in 0 blocks. But p3_rules_C2_p6.npz 'bstar|b05|R-adapt' vs 'bstar|b05|R32' differ in 1 block (7 vs 6 failures), matching p3_rules_C2_p6.txt:29 "bstar b05 7 6 7 16.01 19" (R-adapt stopped at t=19 on a block that R32 later solved). P3.md:138 "R-adapt 의 결과는 모든 블록에서 R32 와 같다(블록별 일치; 세 점 모두)" is unqualified, and the variants' R-adapt is computed and printed by the same code, so the sentence is false as written for the report-only point. Judgement-relevant claims (base runs at the judging point, H6b, net 0/0) are unaffected.
verdicts.fix: Qualify (addition) as: 기본 실행(V1, b*)에서 세 점 모두 블록별 일치; 변형은 C2 +6 dB bstar-b05 에서 1블록 다름(R-adapt 7, R32 6; p3_rules_C2_p6.txt:29).

verdicts.title: H7 verdict '반대 방향 → 지지 아님' is a fourth outcome outside §1's three, and EXPERIMENTS/commit add the gloss '변형이 나쁨'
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. Frozen §1 (P3.md:32) says results are always one of 지지 (p<0.05, fewer failures) / 판정 불가 (p≥0.05, n_d≥6) / UNDECIDED (n_d<6); p<0.05 with more failures maps to none. git show f5856204:conf/code/p3_rules.py:194 already returns "반대 방향 (p < 0.05, 실패 많음) -> 지지 아님" (pre-data, so not post-hoc), and p3_rules_C2_m3.txt:50,54 print it for b* b05 (20:8, p=0.0357) and fb05 (37:18, p=0.0145). §7.1:144-145 reproduces the source label faithfully, but §5.1 (the designated place for pre-data clarifications) does not record this gap. docs/EXPERIMENTS.md:30 and commit d00bb877 write "반대 방향(변형이 нbadness: 변형이 나쁨)" — a quality gloss not present in the source string or the pre-registration; the correct reading is 'variant R16 has more failures at this point (p<0.05), H7 not supported'. No number is wrong.
verdicts.fix: Append to §5.1 (dated) that p<0.05-with-more-failures is printed as '반대 방향 → 지지 아님' (code f5856204, before data); read '변형이 나쁨' in EXPERIMENTS.md:30 / d00bb877 as '변형 R16 의 실패가 많음(p < 0.05), H7 지지 아님' with no quality claim.

verdicts.title: §7.3 marks the H6b prediction '적중' although its '평균 반복 ≈ 18~20' component missed for V1 (17.80)
verdicts.reason: Does not survive. §6 (P3.md:119) writes the iteration count with '≈' ("평균 반복 ≈ 18~20"), and 17.80 (p3_rules_C2_m3.txt:19) rounds to 18, so calling it a hit is within the stated tolerance; the decision-bearing components (both priors supported, net(R-adapt−R32) = 0/0 ≤ +3, adoption = R-adapt) are exactly met. The §7.3 cell (line 172) itself discloses "평균 반복 V1 17.80 은 예측 범위 하한보다 약간 낮고 b* 18.75 는 범위 안", so nothing is hidden and §6 is not misread. This is a wording preference, not a defect in the record.
verdicts.fix: No change required; optionally append '(평균 반복 V1 은 하한 근처)' to the verdict cell if a stricter label is wanted.
